say:1:1611347001:1.text: Magister Merlin, you... you wouldn't happen to be our new headmaster, would you?!
say:1:1611347001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，您……您会成为我们的新校长吗？！
say:1:1611347001:1.male: Magister Merlin, you... you wouldn't happen to be our new headmaster, would you?!
say:1:1611347001:1.female: Magister Merlin, you... you wouldn't happen to be our new headmistress, would you?!

choice_prompt:2:1611347001.text: Magister Merlin, you... you wouldn't happen to be our new headmaster, would you?!
choice_prompt:2:1611347001.source_cn: 梅林大人，您……您会成为我们的新校长吗？！
choice_prompt:2:1611347001.male: Magister Merlin, you... you wouldn't happen to be our new headmaster, would you?!
choice_prompt:2:1611347001.female: Magister Merlin, you... you wouldn't happen to be our new headmistress, would you?!

say:3:1611347002:1.text: I see... That's a shame. If you were headmaster, that'd be incredible. I mean, Headmaster of the Serene Lyceum, Magister Merlin—just hearing it sounds impressive.
say:3:1611347002:1.source_cn: 哦，这样啊……好可惜，如果您能当校长那就最好了。你看—...
say:3:1611347002:1.male: I see... That's a shame. If you were headmaster, that'd be incredible. I mean, Headmaster of the Serene Lyceum, Magister Merlin—just hearing it sounds impressive.
say:3:1611347002:1.female: I see... That's a shame. If you were headmistress, that'd be incredible. I mean, Headmistress of the Serene Lyceum, Magister Merlin—just hearing it sounds impressive.

say:4:1611347003:1.text: Still, if I got a vote, I'd definitely nominate Professor Solise!
say:4:1611347003:1.source_cn: 不过，要是我能投票的话，我会推选娑丽丝老师来当！
say:4:1611347003:1.male: Still, if I got a vote, I'd definitely nominate Professor Solise!
say:4:1611347003:1.female: Still, if I got a vote, I'd definitely nominate Professor Solise!

say:6:1611347004:1.text: She's gentle, approachable, and incredibly patient.
say:6:1611347004:1.source_cn: 娑丽丝老师很温柔、很和善，又很有耐心。
say:6:1611347004:1.male: She's gentle, approachable, and incredibly patient.
say:6:1611347004:1.female: She's gentle, approachable, and incredibly patient.

say:7:1611347005:1.text: I think she understands us. She knows what we're thinking and how to guide and teach us.
say:7:1611347005:1.source_cn: 我觉得……她懂得我们，知道我们都在想什么，也知道该怎样...
say:7:1611347005:1.male: I think she understands us. She knows what we're thinking and how to guide and teach us.
say:7:1611347005:1.female: I think she understands us. She knows what we're thinking and how to guide and teach us.

say:8:1611347006:1.text: And she never gets mad at students, let alone gives out unfair punishments!
say:8:1611347006:1.source_cn: 而且她从来不会对学生发脾气，更没有体罚过学生！
say:8:1611347006:1.male: And she never gets mad at students, let alone gives out unfair punishments!
say:8:1611347006:1.female: And she never gets mad at students, let alone gives out unfair punishments!

say:9:1611347007:1.text: If she were the headmistress, maybe the school rules wouldn't be so bad...
say:9:1611347007:1.source_cn: 要是她当校长，校规或许就不会这么冷冰冰的了吧……
say:9:1611347007:1.male: If she were the headmistress, maybe the school rules wouldn't be so bad...
say:9:1611347007:1.female: If she were the headmistress, maybe the school rules wouldn't be so bad...

choice:2:0:1.text: Someone else will be taking the position.
choice:2:0:1.male: Someone else will be taking the position.
